summary: Defined gRPC service contract and protobuf messages for Spotify integration in pkg/spotify/spotify.proto (SpotifyService with AuthenticateUser, GetTrackMetadata, GetAudioFeatures, GetPreviewURL, RefreshToken RPCs and all associated messages). Created custom error types (ErrAuthFailed, ErrRateLimited, ErrPreviewUnavailable, ErrTokenExpired) with errdefs-compatible SpotifyError wrapper and checker functions in internal/spotify/types.go. Defined TokenStore interface abstracting cloud storage backends. Created SpotifyConfig struct with validation in internal/spotify/config.go. Added comprehensive tests verifying error wrapping, config validation, and interface compliance.
